thread:
Maria P: Heads up — partner flagged confusing outreach from SI + Field during marketplace co-sell. Need a clear mailbox and contact owner.
Ajay R: Heard that. Partner got separate intros from SI and AE within 24h. Bad optics.
Sophie L: Quick data check: 12 overlapping claims last quarter where both SI and Field attempted outreach.
Tom K: Proposed short fix: introduce a canonical partner_mailbox in intake. All outbound comms go through that mailbox until ownership confirmed.
Maria P: Good. Also add a 'confirmed_owner' label in CRM that syncs back to intake.
Ajay R: Rules idea:
- Intake: create claim, set provisional_owner=si|field.
- Until confirmed_owner set, only partner_mailbox can send partner-facing emails.
- SI has 48h to escalate on #partnerships-review with evidence.
- Field can assert ownership immediately only if CRM shows region_owner=true.
Sophie L: Need automation: when SI files an escalation, partner_mailbox sends templated intro and pauses outreach.
Tom K: Technically: add mailbox_id and owner_state to intake schema, webhook idempotency, and an 'outreach_paused' flag. I can ship a small feature flag to test.
Maria P: Legal Bot: any compliance concerns with a shared mailbox approach?
Legal Bot: Shared mailbox ok, but must record consent for marketing comms and include unsubscribe link. Keep audit logs for 3 years per policy.
Ajay R: Also add a do_not_contact flag partners can set when doing joint-announcement prep. Sync to intake.
Sophie L: Edge cases: merged CRM accounts and duplicate partner contacts. Will add merge-detection to reconcile job.
Tom K: Implementation plan:
- PR1: intake schema changes + idempotency (feature flag) due 2026-03-05
- PR2: reconcile job + mailbox routing rules due 2026-03-10
- PR3: UI for manual confirm_owner + audit trail due 2026-03-12
Maria P: Ops: schedule a 20m review after PR2. Also update partner onboarding playbook with mailbox expectations.
Ajay R: I'll draft updated RoE and the partner mailbox template.
Sophie L: I'll run a short sample audit to list affected accounts and post CSV.
Tom K: I'll tag everyone on the branches.
Maria P: Thanks team. Goal: eliminate duplicate partner outreach and lock ownership before joint-announcement window opens. :white_check_mark:
